They mentioned beetle and millipede but did not complete the full list unaided.
Pihu said earthworms live in moist soil, gardens, and under pots.

Teach-back was not passed; lesson ended when Pihu asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming small animals found in soil and leaf litter, including earthworm, ant, beetle, and millipede. They connected earthworms with moist soil and remembered several names near the end. The idea that earthworms spoil soil was not corrected during this short lesson. At home, review the animal names with picture cards and discuss that earthworms help soil rather than spoil it.
